title: sourceAudit
responsibility: Verifies clean committed task source while allowing only bookkeeping changes to an unchanged declared loop contract.

inputs.name: sourceAudit.root
inputs.description: Filesystem root passed to GitAdapter for the HEAD and status reads, and to CommitTreeAdapter.open and loopPaths when input.loop is set. sourceAudit performs no check on this value before those reads.

inputs.name: sourceAudit.input
inputs.description: Declared task checked by sourceAudit: kind must be 'coding' or 'planning', goal must not be blank after trimming, and loop, when set, must be lowercase letters and digits joined by single hyphens. When loop is set, the committed loop.json goal must equal the input goal, the current loop goal and completion must equal their committed values, and any committed completion must match the input kind and plan; units is never read.

examples.goal: Add the evidence grid to the reports component
Plan the completion audit for the reports component

outputs.name: sourceAudit
outputs.description: Full HEAD commit SHA from git rev-parse --verify HEAD^{commit}, returned only after the task-contract and working-tree checks pass.

errors.name: Invalid task completion scope or uncommitted work
errors.description: Thrown for a kind other than 'coding' or 'planning', a blank goal, an invalid loop name, any uncommitted change other than the loop's loop.json and trace.ndjson, an input goal that differs from the committed loop goal, a committed goal that differs from the current loop goal, a current completion that differs from the committed one, or a committed completion whose kind or plan differs from the input. Errors raised by GitAdapter, CommitTreeAdapter, loop-state reads or JSON.parse of the committed loop.json are not caught and reach the caller unchanged.
